name: poll-the-created-discobox
why: 2026-09-29: discobox new polls the discobox it just created, and the poll was refused as 'not part of reading GitHub issues' — the worker's prompt read as the purpose.

Follow CLAUDE.md and update DESIGN.md, run its tests and go tool task check-hooks, drive discobox-review to sign-off, and commit locally on main.
